input: One or two explicitly selected native session JSONL byte snapshots with expected session UUID/cwd/model/provider. Read bounded complete snapshots externally from known session directories, never operator history or auth.
count: For each completed native assistant message, sum input+output+cacheRead+cacheWrite. Preserve categories and native totalTokens separately; reject malformed/missing counters. Native autonomous guard excludes cacheRead and is not this ledger.
unknown: No completed assistant record, missing usage, partial last JSONL record or aborted/error response with unknown zero usage -> accounting incomplete. Never assume zero spend. Repeated session or duplicate entry/response identities rejected, not double-counted.
budget: 120000 combined across contexts. This parser supports admission/stop decisions at completed-record observations, not a hard in-flight token cap. A2 process monitoring remains independent.
no_model_data_or_run: Tests fabricated bytes only. No native session rewrites, provider calls, task data, store discovery or credentials.
